entries.title: Exodus 6:1
segments: And the LORD said to Moses, Now you shall see what I will do to Pharaoh. For with a strong hand he shall let them go, and with a strong hand he shall drive them out of his land.

entries.title: Exodus 6:2
segments: And God spoke to Moses, and said to him, I am Jehovah.

entries.title: Exodus 6:3
segments: And I appeared to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob [as] God Almighty. But I was not known to them [by] the name JEHOVAH.

entries.title: Exodus 6:4
segments: And I also established My covenant with them, to give them the land of Canaan, the land of their pilgrimage, in which they were strangers.

entries.title: Exodus 6:5
segments: And I have also heard the groaning of the sons of Israel, those whom the Egyptians are keeping in bondage. And I have remembered My covenant.

entries.title: Exodus 6:6
segments: Therefore say to the sons of Israel, I [am] Jehovah, and I will bring you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians, and I will rescue you out of their bondage. And I will redeem you with a stretched-out arm, and with great judgments.

entries.title: Exodus 6:7
segments: And I will take you to Me for a people, and I will be to you a God. And you shall know that I [am] the LORD your God, who brings you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians.

entries.title: Exodus 6:8
segments: And I will bring you in to the land concerning which I lifted up My hand to give it to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob. And I will give it to you for a heritage. I [am] the LORD!

entries.title: Exodus 6:9
segments: And Moses said so to the sons of Israel. But they did not listen to Moses through shortness of spirit and through cruel bondage.

entries.title: Exodus 6:10
segments: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

entries.title: Exodus 6:11
segments: Go in, speak to Pharaoh king of Egypt, that he let the sons of Israel go out of his land.

entries.title: Exodus 6:12
segments: And Moses spoke before the LORD, saying, Behold, the sons of Israel have not listened to me. How then shall Pharaoh hear me, since I have lips that are not circumcised?

entries.title: Exodus 6:13
segments: And the LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, and gave them a charge to the sons of Israel, and to Pharaoh king of Egypt, to bring the sons of Israel out of the land of Egypt.

entries.title: Exodus 6:14
segments: These [were] the heads of their fathers' houses: The sons of Reuben the first-born of Israel: Hanoch and Pallu, Hezron and Carmi. These [were] the families of Reuben.

entries.title: Exodus 6:15
segments: And the sons of Simeon: Jemuel, and Jamin, and Ohad, and Jachin, and Zohar, and Shaul, the son of a Canaanitess. These [were] the families of Simeon.

entries.title: Exodus 6:16
segments: And these [were] the names of the sons of Levi, according to their generations: Gershon, and Kohath, and Merari. And the years of the life of Levi [were] a hundred and thirty-seven years.

entries.title: Exodus 6:17
segments: The sons of Gershon: Libni, and Shimei, by their families.

entries.title: Exodus 6:18
segments: And the sons of Kohath: Amram, and Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel. And the years of the life of Kohath [were] a hundred and thirty-three years.

entries.title: Exodus 6:19
segments: And the sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. These [were] the families of Levi according to their generations.

entries.title: Exodus 6:20
segments: And Amram took Jochebed, his father's sister, for his wife. And she bore him Aaron and Moses. And the years of the life of Amram [were] a hundred and thirty-seven years.

entries.title: Exodus 6:21
segments: And the sons of Izhar: Korah, and Nepheg, and Zichri.

entries.title: Exodus 6:22
segments: And the sons of Uzziel: Mishael, and Elzaphan, and Zithri.

entries.title: Exodus 6:23
segments: And Aaron took Elisheba, the daughter of Amminadab, sister of Nahshon, for his wife. And she bore him Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.

entries.title: Exodus 6:24
segments: And the sons of Korah [were] Assir, and Elkanah, and Abiasaph. These [were] the families of the Korahites.

entries.title: Exodus 6:25
segments: And Aaron's son Eleazar took his wife of the daughters of Putiel. And she bore him Phinehas. These [were] the heads of the fathers of the Levites according to their families.

entries.title: Exodus 6:26
segments: It [was] Aaron and Moses to whom the LORD said, Bring out the sons of Israel from the land of Egypt according to their armies.

entries.title: Exodus 6:27
segments: These [were] the ones who spoke to Pharaoh king of Egypt to bring out the sons of Israel from Egypt. It was Moses and Aaron.

entries.title: Exodus 6:28
segments: And it happened on the day the LORD spoke to Moses in the land of Egypt:

entries.title: Exodus 6:29
segments: the LORD spoke to Moses, saying, I [am] the LORD. You speak to Pharaoh king of Egypt all that I say to you.

entries.title: Exodus 6:30
segments: And Moses said before the LORD, Behold, I [am] of uncircumcised lips, and how [shall] Pharaoh listen to me?
